raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified Lord Patrick Crichton-Stuart’s father as John Stuart, 1st Marquess of Bute, by conflating “Lord Mount Stuart” in the Wikipedia snippet with the 1st Marquess. In fact, Lord Patrick was the son of John Stuart, Viscount Mount Stuart (the 1st Marquess’s eldest son), who died in 1794. This misreading redirected the search to the wrong person’s death date (1814) and drove all subsequent steps off course.
